en: And renting can protect you against some of the negative things about the commitment of home ownership. With all of that in mind, here are some guidelines to consider whether renting or buying is best for you. Look at the time that you are planning on spending in one place.
zh: 而租房能让你避开房屋所有权带来的某些负担。考虑到这些，下面几条思路可帮你判断租房还是买房更适合：先看打算在一个地方待多久。

en: Second, buying a home, especially in today's market, can require a significant down payment — often 20% or more of the purchase price. You need to have this amount saved up and be ready to put it down on the house. If you'd rather have the cash on hand for emergencies, college money, vacations or other uses, you might want to think twice about buying a house at this point. Third, unlike renting, home ownership is an investment.
zh: 第二，买房、尤其在今天的市场上，往往需要一笔可观的首付，常是房价的20%甚至更多。你得把这笔钱攒够，随时准备付下去。如果你更希望手头留着现金以备急用、供孩子上学、度假或其他用途，那眼下买房就该三思。第三，与租房不同，拥有住房是一种投资。

en: Consider meeting a financial advisor to go over the figures and determine whether buying a house is a good investment for you or not. Choosing whether to rent or buy is one of the most important decisions in your life, so make sure to take time and consider all factors before making it.
zh: 不妨约一位理财顾问把账算一遍，判断买房对你是否算一笔好投资。租还是买，是人生中最重要的决定之一，务必花时间把各项因素都考虑到再下决定。

en: Many girls in that area never go to school, but in Liberia, a new education program is giving women in their thirties, forties and fifties another chance to learn to read and write. Pauline Rose heads UNESCO's worldwide monitoring report on Education for All. She says being illiterate causes huge problems in daily life. She notes situations like not being able to read directions on a medicine bottle or the number on a bus.
zh: 那个地区许多女孩从没上过学，但在利比里亚，一项新的教育计划正给三四十岁、五十来岁的女性再一次学习读写的机会。波琳·罗斯负责联合国教科文组织《全民教育全球监测报告》。她说，不识字会给日常生活造成很大麻烦，比如看不懂药瓶上的用法说明，或认不出公交车上的号码。

en: But there are still many nations where less than one in four women can read and write. They include Niger, Benin, Mali and Burkina Faso. Ms. Rose says these countries need literacy programs that target women. She says there is a huge need for illiterate young women and adults to have a second chance to read and write. Liberia, for example, has launched a "second chance" literacy campaign to teach women.
zh: 但仍有许多国家，能读会写的女性不到四分之一，包括尼日尔、贝宁、马里和布基纳法索。罗斯女士说，这些国家需要面向女性的扫盲项目；不识字的年轻女性和成年人极其需要第二次读写机会。例如利比里亚就发起了"第二次机会"扫盲运动来教女性。

en: She sells her goods at the market and can now count her profit without help. She says having a second chance at education has changed her life: "Today I am a happy woman. I'm very proud. Liberia's Ministry of Education says 5,000 women currently study in adult literacy programs across the country.
zh: 她在集市上卖货，如今不用别人帮忙就能算出利润。她说，第二次受教育的机会改变了自己的人生："今天我是个幸福的女人，我特别自豪。"利比里亚教育部表示，目前全国有5000名女性在成人扫盲项目中学习。

en: They will spend the next two years in an occupational training program. If the trainees pass the final exam, they will be able to work in Germany as geriatric nurses for another three years. Germany is facing a crisis as low birth rates combine with a growing population of citizens who are living longer. About 20% of the population is over the age of 65, and that percentage is expected to continue rising. This is a problem Japan also faces.
zh: 她们接下来两年将参加一项职业培训项目。若学员通过结业考试，就能再在德国做三年老年护理护士。德国正面临一场危机：出生率走低，同时长寿人口不断增加。约20%的人口超过65岁，这一比例预计还会继续上升——这也是日本同样面对的问题。

en: Yoko Tsuya is the first secretary at Japan's embassy in Hanoi. She says foreign nationals are given some help to complete the test, like being given more time to answer questions. To improve training, the government plans to combine language classes with real-life experience on the job. Even with an aging population, many Japanese are opposed to foreigners working in some industries. Critics say foreign labor could lead to higher unemployment, but there is little opposition to foreign nurses.
zh: Yoko Tsuya 是日本驻河内大使馆的一等秘书。她说外籍人员在完成考试时会得到一些帮助，比如延长答题时间。为改进培训，政府计划把语言课与岗位上的真实经历结合起来。即便人口老龄化，许多日本人仍反对某些行业雇用外国人：批评者说外劳可能推高失业率，但对外籍护士几乎没什么反对声。

en: The first year of college is usually a time to learn and have fun. Many young people enjoy the freedom of living away from home for the first time. For young women in the United States, however, it is a time when they are at high risk of experiencing a sex crime. The US Justice Department reports that American women aged 18 to 24 had the highest rate of sexual assault.
zh: 大学第一年通常是学习、玩乐的时光，许多年轻人第一次享受离家独居的自由。然而对美国年轻女性来说，这也是遭遇性犯罪的高风险期。美国司法部报告称，18至24岁的美国女性性侵发生率最高。

en: The students spent 12 hours learning how to judge risks, deal with emotions and use self-defense. The program taught students to be especially on guard at parties and other high-risk campus social events. The training taught students to attend such events together. If separated, they should check on each other every now and then. They should also take extra care in their use of alcohol. At least half of the sexual assaults among college women involved drinking.
zh: 学生们用12小时学习如何判断风险、处理情绪和使用自卫术。项目特别提醒在聚会及其他高风险校园社交活动中保持警惕，教大家结伴参加；一旦走散，要时不时互相确认；饮酒也要格外当心——大学女生涉及的性侵中至少一半与喝酒有关。

en: The training helps students, both men and women, decide when it is safe to personally intervene and when to call the police. Last year, the President ordered the establishment of a task force on sexual violence at universities. The investigation report advised universities to take several measures. They include methods for researching the sex-crime climate of the university and improving systems for reporting crimes, as well as prevention programs.
zh: 培训帮助男女生判断何时适合亲自出手干预、何时该报警。去年总统下令成立大学性暴力问题工作组，调查报告建议高校采取若干措施，包括调研校园性犯罪氛围的方法、完善报案机制，以及开展预防项目。

en:
— Do you think you can give an exact definition of management, Mr. Rogers?
— Management is the process of achieving results through other people.
— What are the functions of management?
— There are mainly four. The first is planning. Managers define goals, establish strategy and develop plans to coordinate activities.
— That's not easy, I think.
— No.
zh: ——罗杰斯先生，您能给"管理"下一个准确的定义吗？——管理就是通过他人达成结果的过程。——管理有哪些职能？——主要有四项。第一是计划：管理者确定目标、制定战略，并拟定计划来协调各项活动。——我觉得这可不容易。——是不容易。

en: Extroverts may be viewed as bold, confident, loud and full of energy. They are often called "alpha," meaning a leader of the group. Introverted and extroverted people may fit those descriptions. But these same descriptions do not define introversion and extraversion properly. Introverts and extroverts use their brains differently, and they get their energy differently. Introversion is the state of being mostly concerned with one's own mental life.
zh: 外向者常被看作大胆、自信、嗓门大、精力充沛，还常被称作"阿尔法"，即群体里的领导者。内向者和外向者或许都符合这些描述，但这些描述并不能恰当地界定内向与外向。两者用脑方式不同，获取能量的方式也不同。内向，指的是一个人主要关注自己内心世界的状态。

en:
As you know, our current contract is about to expire and we will need to discuss a new one.
— Certainly. We are ready to hear your proposals.
— Something else I'd like to discuss is the possibility of establishing a long-term agreement between my corporation and yours.
— Yes, so long as it's in the interest of both sides, let's talk about it. Is there anything else you'd like to achieve on this visit?
— Yes.
zh: 您知道，我们目前的合同快到期了，需要谈一份新合同。——当然，我们愿意听听贵方的方案。——我还想谈谈，在贵我两家公司之间建立长期协议的可能性。——好，只要符合双方利益，我们就谈。此行您还有别的想达成的目标吗？——有。

en: Today I will talk about nursing home neglect. The problem can occur anywhere and can take many shapes. What makes this particularly dangerous is that it can be overlooked or ignored for so long. Even upon repeated visits to a nursing home, the signs of nursing home neglect can remain hidden. In order to understand the scope of the problem, it is important to know the different types of nursing home neglect. First, personal cleanliness neglect.
zh: 今天我要谈养老院疏于照护的问题。它可能发生在任何地方，形式也多种多样；尤其危险的是，它能被长期忽视或视而不见。即便反复探访养老院，疏于照护的迹象也可能一直藏着。要弄清问题的范围，就得了解它的不同类型。首先是个人清洁方面的疏忽。

en:
— Are you going to the demonstration to help stop the spread of nuclear weapons tomorrow, Cleo?
— No, Simon. I hate demonstrations. I have heard the police will be standing by with tear gas.
— Yes, but North Korea boasts it has nuclear arms.
— 190 countries have signed the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, but the issues are just too complex. There are two sides to every story. I don't understand it, and I'd have no intention of going to a demonstration.
zh: ——克莱奥，明天你要去参加阻止核武器扩散的示威吗？——不去，西蒙，我讨厌示威。听说警察会带着催泪弹在场待命。——可朝鲜宣称自己拥有核武器啊。——190个国家签署了《不扩散核武器条约》，但问题太复杂了，每件事都有两面。我搞不明白，也没打算去示威。

en: Have you ever found yourself in this situation? You hear a song you used to sing when you were a child, but it is not a distant childhood memory. The words come back to you as clearly as when you sang them all those years ago. It seems there is a scientific reason for this. Researchers at the University of Edinburgh studied the relationship between music and remembering a foreign language.
zh: 你有没有遇到过这种情形？听见一首儿时唱过的歌，它却不是遥远的童年回忆，歌词清清楚楚地回到嘴边，就像多年前你唱它时一样。这似乎有科学解释：爱丁堡大学的研究人员研究了音乐与记忆外语之间的关系。

en: For example, Tatify sells a twin rose tattoo or a tiny elephant tattoo for just 2. 99 dollars each. You can also get a selection of strange animal tattoos for 9. 99. The tattoo removal business has grown along with the popularity of tattoos. As many as half of all people who get tattoos later get them removed, reports the Washington Institute of Dermatologic Laser Surgery.
zh: 比如 Tatify 每款双玫瑰纹身或小象纹身只卖2.99美元，花9.99美元还能挑一组稀奇古怪的动物纹身。随着纹身流行，洗纹身的生意也一起壮大。据华盛顿皮肤激光外科研究所报告，纹过身的人里多达一半后来又把它洗掉了。

en: David Holmes of the University of Kansas in the journal American Psychologist said that simply sitting in an armchair has just as many beneficial characteristics for the body as meditation does. Researchers of other relaxation techniques disagree. These experts believe that more structured techniques, such as meditation, lead to a condition of deep relaxation.
zh: 堪萨斯大学的戴维·霍姆斯在《美国心理学家》期刊上说，仅仅坐在扶手椅上，对身体带来的益处就和冥想一样多。研究其他放松技法的专家并不认同：他们认为，像冥想这样更有结构的方法，才能带来深度放松的状态。

en: The jobs are available at the student employment jobs database, from which students can find a variety of jobs both on campus and off campus. In addition to searching for jobs through the jobs database, there are many other ways to find jobs. Some employers will also post their employment information on the website of the student employment office. Some students work consistently over the course of the year, averaging between eight and 12 hours a week.
zh: 这些岗位都收录在学生就业岗位数据库里，学生可以从中找到校内外的各类工作。除了通过数据库检索，找工作的途径还有很多：有些雇主也会把招聘信息发到学生就业办公室的网站上。有些学生一整年持续打工，平均每周8到12小时。

en: It meant housewives tied to the home all day and every day. It meant going to bed early to save lamp oil and coal. Then came the First World War and the Second World War. After each war, new ideas, new attitudes, new trades and occupations were revealed to villagers. The long-established order of society was no longer taken for granted. Electricity and the motor car were steadily operating to make village life and town life almost alike.
zh: 那意味着家庭主妇整天、天天被拴在家里，意味着为了省灯油和煤早早睡觉。后来第一次世界大战、第二次世界大战相继而来。每场战争之后，新观念、新态度、新行当和新职业展现在村民眼前，长久以来的社会秩序不再被视作理所当然。电力和汽车稳步发挥作用，让乡村生活与城镇生活几乎没了分别。

en:
— I don't enjoy dating anymore. I can't seem to find anyone I have anything in common with.
— Don't feel discouraged. Be patient. As you are so distinguished, you will definitely find the person who is right for you.
— To tell you the truth, I'm tired of being alone. I hope to find my missus, right? What should I do?
— Do you believe in internet matchmaking service?
— That's really a new walk of life. What is it exactly?
zh: ——我不想再约会了，好像找不到跟我有共同点的人。——别灰心，耐心点。你这么出众，一定能找到适合你的人。——说实话，我一个人过够了，想找到我的另一半，对吧？我该怎么办？——你信网上婚介服务吗？——那可真是个新鲜行当，具体是什么？

en: For example, loud music is one of those top complaints, and I think, you know, for most reasons, people probably aren't even aware that they are causing problems for their neighbors. And I think if you bring it up to your neighbor's attention, they will be more than happy to fix it. But don't just call the police. You could say something like, you know, "I'm really a light sleeper," or "I suffer from headaches.
zh: 比如，吵闹的音乐是最常见的投诉之一；我想多数情况下，人们大概根本没意识到自己给邻居添了麻烦。我觉得只要你跟邻居提一下，他们多半很乐意改正。但别一上来就叫警察，你可以说点像"我睡觉特别轻"或者"我有头痛的毛病"这样的话。

en:
— Dan, did you want to see me?
— Oh, yes, Sue, please sit down. We need some help.
— What can I do?
— Look at this schedule. There are four conferences in April and there aren't enough representatives to cover all of them.
— But I am not on the executive staff.
— I know, but you have studied management and merchandising, and we have openings for more managerial people. There is a good opportunity for you here.
zh: ——丹，你找我？——哦，是的，苏，请坐。我们需要人手。——我能帮什么？——您看这份日程，四月份有四场会议，可代表人手不够，没法全都覆盖。——可我不是行政人员啊。——我知道，但你学过管理和商品营销，我们正缺管理岗的人，这对你是个好机会。

en: Thank you all for coming to my talk this evening. It's nice to see so many people in the audience. Building team spirit is always the focal point of what I have been trying to do as a manager. When I first went to Crystal Palace, football players would finish training and then go straight home. There was no atmosphere, so we brought in a pool table and fruit machines.
zh: 感谢大家今晚来听我讲，看到这么多听众真高兴。作为一名经理，培养团队精神一直是我努力的核心。我刚到水晶宫队时，球员们训练完就直接回家，一点氛围都没有，于是我们添了台球桌和水果机。

en:
Uh, Dad, you put a little too much salt in it, and besides, it's burned. And what's that?
— Oh, well, that's just part of my own adaptation to the recipe. I added some pumpkin.
— Oh, not another one of your surprises. Pumpkin doesn't go on pizza.
— Well, okay, so what do we do now?
— Well, how about some cold cereal? You can't mess up on that, Dad.
— Oh, I love cereal.
zh: 呃，爸，你盐放多了点，而且还烤糊了。那又是什么？——哦，那是我自己对菜谱做的一点改良，加了些南瓜。——哦，又来一个你的"惊喜"。南瓜哪能放披萨上。——那好吧，现在怎么办？——要不来点冷麦片？这个你总不会搞砸吧，爸。——哦，我爱吃麦片。

en: What if there was an ATM that anyone could use that never charged fees? There is one such ATM actually, and there could be more to come. A company called Free ATMs NYC operates an ATM at a music venue called the Knitting Factory in Brooklyn. All users are welcome to make withdrawals entirely fee-free. While the transaction is occurring, a 15-inch video screen above the ATM shows an advertisement.
zh: 如果有一台人人都能用、从不收手续费的自动取款机，会怎样？还真有这么一台，而且以后可能更多。一家叫"纽约免费 ATM"的公司，在布鲁克林一家名为"编织工厂"的音乐场地运营着一台 ATM，所有用户取款完全免手续费。交易进行的同时，机器上方一块15英寸的屏幕会播放广告。

en:
— One of the most aggressive policies that Princeton has put into place over the last couple of years is matching students' aid packages, so that they need to be allowed to get that aid package for every student.
— All right. Now, speaking of beautiful campuses, Pepperdine scored top, right?
— Pepperdine scored top. It's a lovely campus right on the beach.
zh: ——普林斯顿近几年推行的最激进政策之一，是匹配学生的资助方案，让每名学生都能拿到那份资助。——好。说到最美校园，佩珀代因排第一，对吧？——佩珀代因排第一，校园就在海滩上，美极了。

en: News can be something the authorities want you to know, or something they would rather keep secret: an announcement of a government success, a denial of a failure, or a secret scandal that nobody really wants you to talk about. If the authorities want to tell the world some good news, they issue statements and call press conferences, or politicians make speeches. Local newspapers, radio and television help to alert foreign correspondents to what is going on.
zh: 新闻可以是当局想让你知道的事，也可以是他们宁可保密的事：政府成就的公告、对失败的否认，或者谁都不希望你谈论的秘密丑闻。若当局想向全世界发布好消息，就发声明、开记者会，或由政客发表演讲；当地报纸、广播和电视则帮助提醒外国记者留意正在发生什么。

en:
— What's really amazing to me is that leaving "e" out in French is no easy job, and doing it in English is going to involve a completely different group of words. It's a real work of mine — I mean, a real work of art.
— Sometime you have to show me that book, but right now I'd better get going on the writing for next week.
zh: ——真正让我惊叹的是，法语里省掉字母"e"已经很不容易，换成英语又得牵涉完全不同的一批词。这真是我的作品——我是说，一件真正的艺术品。——哪天你得把那本书给我看看，不过现在我得赶紧去写下周要用的稿子了。

en: In Vietnam, the daily cooking is not much different from eating out. You eat almost the same type of food back home and in restaurants; there's nothing too different from what you get in a restaurant, which in other countries may be considered more special than the homemade food. One of the most famous Vietnamese dishes is the spring roll, and in Vietnamese it's called "nem.
zh: 在越南，家常做饭和下馆子差别不大：在家和餐馆吃的几乎是同一类食物，没什么比餐馆里更特别的东西，而在别的国家，餐馆菜往往比家常菜更讲究。越南最有名的菜之一是春卷，越南语叫"nem"。

en:
Some of the larger branches fell over into my yard and I think you should come and get them.
— Listen, Jane, I don't see why I should do that. You eat all the apples that fall in your yard and you've never complained about that before.
— Well, it's easier to pick up apples than drag tree branches all the way to the curb. My kids pick up the apples, and the branches are just too big for them to drag.
zh: 有几根大点的树枝倒到我院子里了，我觉得你该过来把它们弄走。——听着，简，我不明白凭什么要我弄。掉在你院里的苹果你全都吃了，以前也从没抱怨过呀。——嗯，捡苹果可比把树枝一路拖到路边容易多了。苹果我孩子们捡，树枝太大，他们拖不动。

en: Every year, most new employees employed by McKinsey and Company, the big boss of the management consulting industry, are HBS graduates. The investment banks on Wall Street are where HBS graduates go to report in crowds. The MBA has become the symbol of power and wealth, and is the degree that numerous people both in America and all over the world dream of — or rather, desire. HBS is the founder of the MBA, and there is a legend about it.
zh: 每年，管理咨询业龙头麦肯锡公司招的新员工大多是哈佛商学院毕业生；华尔街的投资银行更是哈佛商学院毕业生成群去报到的地方。MBA 已成为权力与财富的象征，是无数美国人乃至全世界人梦寐以求——不如说渴望——的学位。哈佛商学院是 MBA 的开创者，关于它还有一段传奇。

en:
Most people do, but there are actually 11 official languages. English is one; the most commonly spoken language that's native to the area would be Zulu.
— And how about the population there?
— Interestingly, South Africa has the largest population of people of European descent in Africa, and the largest Indian population outside of Asia. Not only that, it also has the largest mixed-race community in Africa.
— Oh, you really know a lot about that country now.
zh: 多数人这么以为，其实官方语言有11种，英语是其一；当地原生语言里说得最多的是祖鲁语。——那儿的人口情况呢？——有意思的是，南非拥有非洲最多的欧洲裔人口，也是亚洲之外印度裔人口最多的国家；不仅如此，它还有非洲最大的混血社群。——哦，你对那个国家现在可真了解了。

en: Even mild dehydration can drain your energy and make you tired. Every day you must replenish its water supply by consuming drinks and food that contain water. So how much water does an average, healthy adult living in a temperate climate need? In general, doctors recommend eight or nine cups. Here are the most common ways of calculating that amount. First, eight 8-ounce glasses of water a day.
zh: 即便轻度脱水也会耗尽精力、让人疲倦。每天你都得靠含水的饮品和食物补回身体的水分。那么，生活在温和气候下的健康成年人平均需要多少水？医生一般建议八到九杯。下面是几种最常见的算法：第一，每天八杯8盎司的水。

en: Americans are suffering from a serious sleep deficit as they spend more time on leisure activities. A world that never goes to sleep offers many diverse activities, but encourages unhealthy and sometimes anti-social lifestyles for American adults. Instead of working to live, they are living to work — a shift that has had a profound impact on their personal lives. Adults report spending less time sleeping and more time engaged in social and leisure activities.
zh: 美国人正饱受严重的睡眠亏空，因为他们把更多时间花在休闲活动上。一个永不入睡的世界提供了五花八门的活动，却也在怂恿美国成年人过不健康、有时甚至反社交的生活方式。他们不再是"为生活而工作"，而是"为工作而生活"——这一转变深刻影响了私人生活。成年人报告说，睡觉时间变少，社交和休闲时间变多。

en: "At the age of ten you get up and go to school, and it fits in with our nine-to-five lifestyle," Kelly said. Ignoring our natural body clock could lead to exhaustion, frustration, anxiety, weight gain and high blood pressure, he said, and could make a person more prone to alcohol use and risk-taking. The recommendations arise from a deeper understanding of our internal body clock, which determines optimum levels of concentration, wakefulness and work ability.
zh: 凯利说："十岁时你起床去上学，这正好契合我们朝九晚五的生活方式。"他说，无视人体的天然生物钟可能导致疲惫、沮丧、焦虑、体重增加和高血压，还会让人更容易酗酒和冒险。这些建议源自对人体内生物钟更深入的理解——它决定了注意力、清醒度和工作能力的最佳水平。

en: And all of a sudden they found that local people started to play it, and it very quickly became known as "the street piano". At some point the council threatened to take it away because they said it was an obstruction to the pavement. Then all the local players were up in arms about it and put notes all over the piano saying "Please save the street piano".
zh: 忽然之间，他们发现当地人开始弹它，它很快就以"街头钢琴"闻名。有一阵子，市政委员会扬言要把它搬走，说它妨碍人行道通行。于是所有常来弹琴的人都很愤慨，在钢琴上贴满纸条："请救救街头钢琴"。

en: A third group slept in front of a white light, while a fourth was put in front of a red light. After four weeks, the researchers noted how much sugary water the rats drank. They found that the more depressed animals drank the least amount of water. Randy Nelson heads the department of neuroscience at Ohio State University. He says animals that slept in blue and white light appeared to be the most depressed.
zh: 第三组睡在白光前，第四组则被放在红光前。四周后，研究人员记录老鼠喝了多少糖水，发现越抑郁的动物喝得最少。兰迪·纳尔逊是俄亥俄州立大学神经科学系主任。他说，睡在蓝光和白光下的动物看起来最抑郁。

en:
— I'd like to try it just for a month or so. Do they have trial memberships?
— The shortest membership time is one month. Then if you like it, you can join for longer periods, and it becomes cheaper. A six-month membership costs as much as five individual months.
— Sounds pretty easy. Maybe next time I run into you again it'll be at the checkout line in the co-op.
zh: ——我就想试一个月左右，他们有体验会员吗？——最短的会期就是一个月。之后你要是喜欢，可以办更长的，价格也更划算：办六个月的钱只相当于按月的五个月。——听着挺省事。也许下次再碰见你，就是在合作社的收银台排队了。

en: This works well for many classic or staple items, like suits, pants or jeans, that aren't prone to going out of style too quickly. Trendy items may be a riskier purchase, as they tend to become out of date after a season or two. Though it's prudent to follow these guidelines for money-saving shopping, also keep in mind that bargains can be found at any time during the year and in every season.
zh: 这对西装、长裤、牛仔裤这类不易过时的经典款或基础款很管用；潮流单品买起来风险更大，往往一两季就过时了。虽然按这些省钱指南来买是明智的，但也别忘了：一年里任何时候、每个季节都能淘到便宜货。

en: In the United States, many have been told that anyone can become rich and successful if he works hard and has some good luck. When one becomes rich, he wants people to know it. And even if he does not become very rich, he still wants people to think that he is. That's what "keeping up with the Joneses" is about. The expression was first used in 1913 by a young American named Arthur Momand.
zh: 在美国，很多人都被告知：只要肯努力、再加点好运，人人都能致富成功。一个人真富了，就想让别人知道；即便没那么富，也希望别人以为自己富。这就是"跟琼斯家攀比"的由来。这个说法1913年由一个叫阿瑟·莫曼德的美国年轻人首次使用。

en: The term "big data" generally refers to the idea of analysing enormous volumes of information to make better business decisions and improve the performance of a company's internal computer systems. Additionally, all that information doesn't have to be stored in one place; it can be scattered across multiple databases and systems.
zh: "大数据"一词通常指分析海量信息，以做出更好的商业决策、提升公司内部计算机系统的性能。而且，所有这些信息不必集中存放在一处，可以分散在多个数据库和系统里。

en: I know — I have been an early airport person for years. My luggage will get on the plane first, but it will be the last luggage to come off the plane when we land. You know who really gets his luggage first when we land? The late airport person who rushes into the airport three minutes before the plane takes off. "But if I get there really, really early," I told myself, "I will get the best seat.
zh: 我懂——我多年来都是那个早早到机场的人。我的行李会先上飞机，可落地时却是最晚下来的。你知道落地后谁的行李反而最先到？是那个起飞前三分钟才冲进机场的"迟到客"。"可我要是到得特别特别早，"我跟自己说，"就能挑到最好的座位。"

en: Not enough American students want to be engineers, mathematicians or scientists. The federal government wants to change that — and it's spending money to do it. The government will invest 3 billion dollars in the education of young Americans in science, technology, engineering and maths. The four areas together are known as STEM. Many jobs in the STEM fields will open in the coming years. The US government's investment aims to increase the number of Americans who can take those jobs.
zh: 想当工程师、数学家或科学家的美国学生不够多，联邦政府想改变这一点，而且正在花钱去做：将向美国年轻人的科学、技术、工程和数学教育投入30亿美元，这四个领域合称 STEM。未来几年 STEM 领域会开放大量岗位，政府这笔投资意在增加能胜任这些工作的美国人数量。

en: As a general rule, the more native plants are planted in the yard, the more birds will come. Some birds are so particular that you must have the special plant that they demand, while others only demand that you provide their basic needs. Most birds require some shelter for roosting, preening and sleeping. By varying the height as well as the density of plants, a greater number of species are encouraged to seek out shelter in your yard.
zh: 一般来说，院子里种的本土植物越多，引来的鸟就越多。有些鸟特别挑剔，你必须种上它们指定的那种植物；另一些只要求你提供基本所需。多数鸟需要一定的庇护处来栖息、理羽和睡觉。让植物在高度和密度上富有变化，就能吸引更多种类的鸟来你院里安身。

en: According to other news agencies, health officials have reported many cases of microcephaly in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Reuters news agency reports that the Zika virus has been confirmed this year in Panama, Venezuela, El Salvador, Mexico, Suriname, Colombia, Guatemala and Paraguay. Zika is also found in Africa and Southeast Asia. The CDC has a web page with information on Zika.
zh: 据其他通讯社消息，卫生官员在里约热内卢和圣保罗报告了许多小头畸形病例。路透社报道，今年巴拿马、委内瑞拉、萨尔瓦多、墨西哥、苏里南、哥伦比亚、危地马拉和巴拉圭都已确认出现寨卡病毒；非洲和东南亚也有寨卡。美国疾控中心设有介绍寨卡的网页。

en: Today we continue our series on ecology and conservation with a look at a particularly endangered member of the black bear family. One in ten black bears is actually born with a white coat, which is the result of a special gene that surfaces in a few. Local people have named it the spirit bear. And according to the legends of these communities, its snowy fur brings with it a special power.
zh: 今天我们继续生态与保育系列，来看黑熊家族中一位尤其濒危的成员。每十只黑熊里就有一只生来披着白毛，这是少数个体身上显现出的特殊基因所致。当地人称它"灵熊"；按这些族群的传说，它雪白的皮毛带着一种特殊的力量。

en: He has been working to create a better carrot for 35 years. He says the local-food movement in North America and elsewhere is responsible for the increased interest in the flavour of food. He says the more extensive local production of vegetables has caused buyers to seek better quality. He says local growers are seeking to provide more kinds of vegetables to meet the demand of buyers.
zh: 35年来，他一直在培育更好的胡萝卜。他说，北美等地的本地食物运动，正是人们对食物风味兴趣上升的原因；蔬菜本地化种植更广，促使买家追求更好的品质；而本地种植者也正设法提供更多品种的蔬菜来满足买家需求。

zh: ——女士们、先生们，大家好。我很荣幸介绍今天讲座的主讲人。帕特里夏·瑞安是一位资深英语教师，她提出一个发人深省的问题：全世界对英语的专注，是否阻碍了其他语言中伟大思想的传播？换句话说，假如爱因斯坦也得考托福呢？这是一场对翻译与思想分享的热切辩护。现在有请帕特里夏·瑞安。——谢谢。

en: He says the trade enables young people to buy cigarettes at low prices, become addicted to tobacco and suffer serious health problems. It also increases crime and reduces tax revenue. The World Health Organization is urging United Nations member states to sign a treaty to end the illegal trade in tobacco products. Eight countries have approved the treaty, but the approval of 32 other countries is needed for it to become international law.
zh: 他说，这种贸易让年轻人以低价买到香烟、染上烟瘾并遭受严重的健康问题，还会推高犯罪、减少税收。世界卫生组织正敦促联合国成员国签署一项条约，终止烟草制品的非法贸易。目前已有8个国家批准，但还需另外32个国家批准，条约才能成为国际法。
